message.content:
Second independent check. Is this M12 code-review finding a REAL, actionable bug/issue that should be fixed before merge? Read the code yourself. Be skeptical — confirm only if you can point to the concrete problem in the diff.

Lens: reuse
File: components/customer/UpcomingBookings.tsx (UpcomingBookings render, line 77 — `{item.providerName} · {item.blockMinutes} min`)
Title: Hardcoded "min" suffix bypasses messages/en.json
Detail: The minutes label is rendered as a hardcoded `{item.blockMinutes} min` string in JSX. This violates CLAUDE.md rule 7 (all user-facing copy through messages/en.json) and is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase, which renders minutes via i18n everywhere else: `t("provider.minutesShort", { minutes })` (SessionsTable, IncomingRequests, provider dashboard), `t("summary.minutesValue", { minutes })` (session summary), and `t("receipt.minutes", { minutes })` (the receipt route in this same diff). The literal " min" will not localize.

content.text:
Finding confirmed in full. Let me note the distinction in `lib/format.ts` line 15 which also has a hardcoded `min`, but that's a separate pre-existing utility, not part of the cited finding. The finding is specifically about line 77 of UpcomingBookings.tsx.

Let me verify the precise facts:
- Line 77 renders `{item.providerName} · {item.blockMinutes} min` — hardcoded " min" confirmed.
- `provider.minutesShort` = `"{minutes} min"` exists (line 210), used in SessionsTable, IncomingRequests, provider dashboard — confirmed.
- `summary.minutesValue` = `"{minutes} min"` exists (line 332), used in summary page — confirmed.
- `receipt.minutes` = `"{minutes} min"` exists (line 424), used in the receipt route — confirmed.
- The file already imports `t` from `@/lib/i18n` (line 12) and uses it extensively — so the fix is trivial and the pattern is established.

This is a real, actionable bug. It directly violates CLAUDE.md golden rule 7 ("All user-facing copy goes through `messages/en.json`"), the literal " min" string is rendered in user-facing JSX, and an existing i18n key (`provider.minutesShort` = `"{minutes} min"`) produces identical output and is already used in three sibling components.

input.reason:
Confirmed real and actionable. In components/customer/UpcomingBookings.tsx line 77, the minutes label is rendered as a hardcoded string: `{item.providerName} · {item.blockMinutes} min`. The literal " min" is user-facing copy embedded directly in JSX, which violates CLAUDE.md golden rule 7 (all user-facing copy must go through messages/en.json) and the project's Definition of Done.

The inconsistency claim checks out: every other place that renders minutes uses i18n. Verified usages:
- `t("provider.minutesShort", { minutes })` in components/provider/SessionsTable.tsx (lines 31, 38), components/provider/IncomingRequests.tsx (line 55), and app/(provider)/provider/dashboard/page.tsx (line 180).
- `t("summary.minutesValue", { minutes })` in app/(customer)/session/[id]/summary/page.tsx (lines 74, 81).
- `t("receipt.minutes", { minutes })` in app/(customer)/account/receipt/[bookingId]/route.ts (lines 49, 51) — same diff.

The required key already exists and produces identical output: messages/en.json line 210 defines `provider.minutesShort` = "{minutes} min". The fix is trivial because UpcomingBookings.tsx already imports `t` from "@/lib/i18n" (line 12) and uses it throughout (e.g., t("account.join"), t("account.reschedule")), so line 77 can become `{item.providerName} · {t("provider.minutesShort", { minutes: item.blockMinutes })}`. The hardcoded " min" will not localize and is inconsistent with the established pattern.

Minor note: lib/format.ts line 15 also hardcodes " min" in a utility, but that is pre-existing code outside the cited finding and not part of this review item.
